entry.title: Meta to price Muse Charm gadget at $300: The Information
entry.summary: The device that carries the viral Muse AI agent into the real world was unveiled in September by chief executive Mark Zuckerberg during the company's annual conference. Muse Charm underscores Meta's broader push to reduce its reliance on Apple and Google's operating systems by building its own AI platform.

entry.title: Bajaj Finserv and Pennant invest $4 million in Indian AI startup Soket AI
entry.summary: Bajaj Finance and Pennant Technologies are backing Soket AI with investments of around $2 million each to advance its homegrown foundation models and enterprise AI solutions.

entry.title: Trump administration weighs forcing US firms to disclose Chinese AI use
entry.summary: The Treasury Department and the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy (OSTP) have discussed the plan, which would apply to companies such as Airbnb, the people said. The company uses Qwen, an AI model made by China's Alibaba , to power its AI customer service agent.
